title: Turns
description: A session's turns on its page, as a part: one line a turn, the beats it told among them, and a turn followed up as a task. It reads the runs pack's turns and story; a session is core's run.

actions.title: Follow up a turn
actions.description: Make a task of a session's turn: what it asked, or what it did, as work on the map about the session, on its island.

run.description: The session, by its run's id.

said.description: What the turn asked, or what it did: the task's title is its first clause, its note the whole.

at.description: When the turn began (ISO), named in the task's note.
